Drawbacks
Debauchery Defier
Source Heroes of the High Court pg. 3
Category Basic (Social)
Requirement(s) Associate with the court of the Imperial Palace of Taldor
You are particularly adept at resisting addiction. You must fail two saving throws in a row to become addicted to a drug.
